# STOA Platform

> The European Agent Gateway — open-source, AI-native API management for MCP and enterprise workloads.

## What is STOA?

STOA is an open-source API management platform (Apache 2.0) that bridges traditional APIs and AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It provides multi-tenant isolation, GitOps-first configuration, and European data sovereignty (NIS2/DORA compliance).

## Key Features

- **MCP Gateway**: Native Model Context Protocol support — AI agents discover and call APIs automatically
- **Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Hard isolation with Kubernetes namespaces, Keycloak realms, and schema-per-tenant databases
- **AI Gateway**: Token metering, semantic caching, smart routing across LLM providers
- **GitOps Native**: ArgoCD integration for declarative tenant provisioning
- **European Sovereign**: EU hosting with full data residency control, NIS2/DORA supportive
- **Universal API Contract (UAC)**: Define once, expose everywhere — normalized API definitions
- **Legacy Bridge**: Migration paths from webMethods, Kong, Apigee, Oracle OAM

## Architecture

```
CONTROL PLANE (Cloud)                    DATA PLANE (On-Premise/Hybrid)
+----------------------------+           +----------------------+
| Portal  Console  API  Auth |  <-sync-> | MCP Gateway  Sidecar |
| (React) (React) (Py) (KC) |           | (Rust)       (Rust)  |
+----------------------------+           +----------------------+
```

## Components

| Component | Technology | Description |
|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| Control Plane API | Python, FastAPI | Tenant, API, and gateway management |
| Console UI | React, TypeScript | Admin interface |
| Developer Portal | React, TypeScript | API catalog and subscription management |
| MCP Gateway | Rust, Tokio, axum | High-performance MCP-native gateway |
| STOA Gateway | Rust | Data plane gateway with 4 deployment modes |
